dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hey, people of Dornman Port! I'm opening a tavern here soon, specializing in premium fruit wine imported straight from Sumeru! Make sure you come by and support the business!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Wait. You're planning to import fruit wine from Sumeru... and sell it here?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Exactly! That's how business works! I even paid a fortune-teller from Sumeru in Nasha Town for advice. She said my tavern is guaranteed to make a fortune!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Uh-huh. And where are you planning to open it?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Right next to Boss Frith's place, ideally. She sells wine, I sell wine — it's what the fortune-teller called a 'commercial cluster.' Once that's in place, the money just rolls in!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "...Though the rent around there might be pretty steep. I might not get the place even with a loan. But if that doesn't work out, I'll just open up on Windrest Peak instead. Fewer customers maybe, but the profits should still be great!"
